claims.text: Engineering the Nation's Growth Since 1938
L&T House, Ballard Estate, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India is the headquarters.
This brochure is an independently compiled profile based on public information and is not an official L&T publication.

Larsen & Toubro Limited (L&T) is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in Mumbai, founded in 1938 by Danish engineers Henning Holck-Larsen and Søren Kristian Toubro and incorporated in 1946.
Today the group operates in more than 50 countries and is listed on the NSE and BSE (ticker: LT), with no single majority shareholder.
S N Subrahmanyan is the Chairman & Managing Director.
R Shankar Raman is a Whole-time Director, President & CFO.
Subramanian Sarma is the Deputy Managing Director & President.
S V Desai is a Whole-time Director.
T Madhava Das is a Whole-time Director & Senior EVP, Utilities.

Statue of Unity, Gujarat is the world's tallest statue including its access infrastructure.
Mumbai Trans Harbour Link (MTHL) is India's longest sea bridge.
Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail (MAHSR) includes civil works such as viaducts, stations and river bridges on the C4 package.
Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA) is mentioned.
Dhubri-Phulbari Bridge, Assam-Meghalaya is India's longest river bridge over the Brahmaputra.
Hyderabad Metro Rail is one of the world's largest metro rail projects executed on a PPP basis.
Riyadh Metro, Saudi Arabia includes systems and integration works.
Engineering, procurement and construction of buildings & factories, transportation infrastructure, heavy civil works, power transmission & distribution, and water & renewable energy projects.
End-to-end EPC for upstream, midstream and downstream oil & gas, and power generation infrastructure.

Design, manufacture and supply of engineered equipment for process plants, nuclear and green-hydrogen facilities, marine and land defence platforms, aerospace systems, and precision electronics for defence, security and space.

Global IT services, digital solutions, engineering R&D, e-commerce/digital platforms, data centres and semiconductor chip-design solutions are delivered through group entities such as LTIMindtree and L&T Technology Services.
Retail finance, wholesale finance and investment management are delivered through L&T Finance Holdings.
Roads and transmission assets, the Hyderabad Metro Rail project, power development projects, and premium residential & commercial real estate through L&T Realty.
L&T operates at the intersection of engineering, construction, heavy manufacturing, information technology, defence and financial services.
L&T is commonly classified under the capital goods / infrastructure & engineering sector in India.
L&T serves customers across more than 50 countries.
